description: This header file defines interfaces, macros, constants, and data structures for managing telephony voice service features in a software stack, specifically related to TR-181 data model for telco voice management. It contains function prototypes for getting, setting, validating, committing, and rolling back configuration parameters and managing lists of voice-related entities like SIP servers, call logs, extensions, etc.

methods.name: VoiceService_IsUpdated
methods.description: Checks if the voice service configuration has been updated.

methods.name: VoiceService_Synchronize
methods.description: Synchronizes the voice service data with the underlying hardware or configuration.

methods.name: VoiceService_GetEntryCount
methods.description: Returns the count of voice service entries.

methods.name: VoiceService_GetEntry
methods.description: Retrieves a specific voice service entry by index.

methods.name: VoiceService_GetParamUlongValue
methods.description: Fetches a ULONG-type parameter value for a given voice service context.

methods.name: VoiceService_SetParamUlongValue
methods.description: Sets a ULONG-type parameter value for a given voice service context.

methods.name: VoiceService_Validate
methods.description: Validates current configuration before applying changes.

methods.name: VoiceService_Commit
methods.description: Commits configuration changes to underlying hardware or persistent storage.

methods.name: VoiceService_Rollback
methods.description: Rolls back configuration to previous state if validation or commit fails.
